name: Wabigoon Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a 1978 MNRF transect survey (year from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 18.1 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (87.4% of water cells at >=0.4). Cool-regime lake; sauger and cisco in the ARA community. Muskellunge confirmed (ARA). Secchi 4 m is a FALLBACK default (ARA Secchi null).
